entities.title: zazzle and its tools
entities.summary: zazzle, the launcher, and every tool it runs, one folder per tool with a plain descriptive name, in any language; also the Cargo workspace and the Rust and C# rules for agents.
entities.purpose: Holds the launcher (zazzle/, C), the daemon (daemon/), the language modules and the zazz script crates (language-modules/, zazz-script/), the shell-tools library the daemon links (shell-tools/), the standalone tools (fix-network/, free-disk-space/, git-tools/, ai-agent/, ai-agent-rules/), the C# tools (csharp-indexer/, csharp-minifier/) and the vendored LZFSE library (lempel-ziv-finite-state-entropy-compression/). Only zazzle is a command on PATH; an install puts every other tool in libexec/zazzle, where `zazzle TOOL` runs it. The folder is named for the tools' primary platform: zazzle, the daemon and csharp-indexer also build and run on Linux.
boundaries: A grouping folder: the tools share settings, not code; only the zazz-script crates are shared (the daemon uses packaging and engine, runner uses engine).

The Cargo workspace (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rustfmt.toml, rust-style.md) covers the Rust folders; the release profile uses link-time optimization, stripped symbols and one codegen unit. ai-agent is left out of release workspace builds (`--exclude ai-agent`) and built by release/tools.sh.
zazz-script/runner embeds wasmtime and sets its own minimum Rust version (1.97); the rest of the workspace keeps 1.85.
lempel-ziv-finite-state-entropy-compression/ is changed only by copying a new version from the lzfse-compression repository.
Build output (target/, bin/, obj/, out/, build/) is never committed.
